blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police seized suspected smuggled cigarettes worth P3.7 million from a closed van at a checkpoint in the Special Geographic Area (SGA) of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on Wednesday evening, October 28. The Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR) said personnel from the 1405th Maneuver Company of the Regional Mobile Force Battalion 14-A and the Malidegao Municipal Police Station flagged down a Foton closed van for inspection at a police checkpoint in Barangay Batulawan, Malidegao, SGA-BARMM at around 6:30 p.m. Malidegao municipal police station chief Maj.
